mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_send_log ( user_id, mobile_no, device_no, otp_token, otp_code, purpose, provider_success ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{mobileNo}, #{deviceNo}, #{otpToken}, #{otpCode}, #{purpose}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_send_log SET provider_code = #{providerCode}, provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, provider_success = #{providerSuccess, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.BooleanTinyintTypeHandler}, provider_error_code = #{errorCode}, provider_error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{logId}
